def rerank(candidates: list, scores: list, k: int) -> list:
    """Return the top-k candidates ordered by their rerank score (desc)."""
    pairs = zip(candidates, scores)
    ranked = sorted(pairs, key=lambda p: p[1], reverse=True)
    return [c for c, _ in ranked[:k]]

print(rerank(["doc_a", "doc_b", "doc_c"], [0.2, 0.9, 0.5], 2))
